title: HydroCast Deployment View: Linux Docker vs Windows Server
verified_deployments: Linux Docker: hydrocast-db (:5432), hydrocast-backend (:8000), hydrocast-frontend (:3000), hydrocast-docs (:8001), hydrocast-dev (:8000, :8888)
